{{Top|leg}}
'''Truant Sweeps''' were occasional sweeps of the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Kegan/Legends|Kegan]] by [[Truant Guide]]s to ensure no students were skipping school at the [[Learning Circle]]. [[V-Tarz]], one Truant Guide, captured [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and [[Siri Tachi/Legends|Siri Tachi]] during a sweep, not believing they were visitors to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]]. Although he had been told by [[Security Guide]] [[V-Brose]] that physical force was not necessary, V-Tarz used an electro-jabber to capture the truants, then roughly hauled them back to the Learning Circle in a [[Landspeeder/Legends|landspeeder]].
